MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into as of February 30, 2025 between Northwind Logistics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Provider"), and Harbor Point Retail LLC, a New York limited liability company ("Customer"). This Agreement is executed under seal and acknowledged before a notary public.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

1. Definitions
2. Services
3. Fees
4. Term and Termination
9. Confidentiality
12. Dispute Resolution

1. Definitions

1.1 "Services" means the logistics and warehousing services described in each Statement of Work.

1.3 "Fee Cap" means the maximum aggregate amount payable in any Contract Year.

2. Services

2.1 Provider shall perform the Services in accordance with each Statement of Work. The appropriate party shall maintain the inventory records required by applicable law.

2.2 Where a discrepancy arises in the inventory count, the responsible party shall reconcile the count within [insert number] business days.

4. Fees

4.1 Customer shall pay Provider an annual fee of Fifty Thousand Dollars ($75,000), payable in four equal quarterly installments.

4.2 The Fee Cap for the initial Contract Year is $50,000. The Fee Cap for the initial Contract Year is CAD $120,000 where the Services are performed from the Toronto facility.

4.3 Late payment of any invoice shall bear interest at 36% per annum until paid in full.

4.4 Expense reimbursement shall be submitted on form TBD and approved by XXX prior to payment.

3. Services

3.1 Provider shall provide the additional services set out in Exhibit B.

5. Term and Termination

5.1 The initial term of this Agreement is twelve (12) months from the Effective Date and expires on December 31, 2025.

5.2 Either party may elect not to renew this Agreement by giving eighteen (18) months' prior written notice of non-renewal.

5.3 This Agreement renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal not less than 15 days before the end of the then-current term.

5.4 Provider may terminate this Agreement immediately upon Customer's failure to pay any invoice when due.

5.5 Any notice of termination shall be in writing and delivered by hand or by nationally recognized overnight courier to the address set forth in Section 14.

5.6 Customer shall deliver the final reconciliation statement on March 15, 2026 and shall deliver the closing inventory certificate on June 1, 2026.

5. Term and Termination

5.7 The provisions of this Section survive termination.

7.1 Provider shall retain the records described in Section 7.2 for seven years.

7.3 Customer may inspect those records on reasonable notice.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
